Original Decipher card face for [[Endor (Dark)]], rotated 180° from the archive scan [[:File:Endor-D-endor-decipher-archive.gif]], no other change. Decipher's Dark Side card list scan shows this card Light Side up; this copy turns it so the Dark Side text reads the right way up. The rotation is lossless: same pixels and palette, no crop, no rescaling.

Source: [http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/images/endor.gif endor.gif], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000828093910/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/images/endor.gif Internet Archive], 28 August 2000. SHA-256 of the archived file: f59dcbe4b1ea07974c42699b27de7d36c29b0cdc38d1fb8bb82432ec35559334.

The PC Holotable face is [[:File:Endor-D-endor.gif]] and is not replaced by this file.
